content.title: Emotional Purge Conversion | Photo Release, Appraisal Proof and Cash Payoff
content.summary: An adult watchmaker clears old photos, appraises a found clock case and reaches a modest relief payoff. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult protagonist and one disposal container persist. + The emotional low is evidenced before any solution appears. + The valuable object is visibly discovered and remains traceable through appraisal. + Payment follows a completed inspection and cannot appear from nowhere. + The final relief preserves memory of the preceding causal chain.
quick_start.recommended_input: Begin with one original adult watchmaker in tears beside six printed photos and one black storage bag. She notices one copper mechanical clock case beside the bag, lifts it and verifies three brass fittings. The watchmaker receives the stated payment, exhales once and ends in a warm illustrated portrait holding the receipt, not the discarded photos.
required_anchors: One clearly adult protagonist and one disposal container persist.
The emotional low is evidenced before any solution appears.
Payment follows a completed inspection and cannot appear from nowhere.
The final relief preserves memory of the preceding causal chain.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult watchmaker clears old photos, appraises a found clock case and reaches a modest relief payoff. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先用同一成年人物的泪痕和旧照片建立关系低谷，再让她把照片装入一个可追踪袋子、发现可变现物件并完成柜台交易；现金结果必须来自已展示物件，终局情绪由悲伤转为释然。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult protagonist and one disposal container persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult protagonist and one disposal container persist."

invariants.rule: The emotional low is evidenced before any solution appears.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The emotional low is evidenced before any solution appears."

invariants.rule: The valuable object is visibly discovered and remains traceable through appraisal.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The valuable object is visibly discovered and remains traceable through appraisal."

invariants.rule: Payment follows a completed inspection and cannot appear from nowhere.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Payment follows a completed inspection and cannot appear from nowhere."

invariants.rule: The final relief preserves memory of the preceding causal chain.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final relief preserves memory of the preceding causal chain."
